disclaimer: SYNTHETIC demonstration data - not government statistics. Only district names and centroids are real.
underserved_rule: coverage_pct is not null AND coverage_pct < max_coverage_pct AND gap >= min_gap_<level>

metric_definitions.assessed: citizen x scheme assessments (rows) in the area
metric_definitions.potentially_eligible: assessments pending documents (not part of coverage)
metric_definitions.coverage_pct: enrolled / eligible * 100, half-up to 1 decimal; null when eligible = 0
metric_definitions.top_missing_documents.citizens: distinct eligible or potentially eligible, not enrolled citizens lacking the document

geo_attribution: District boundaries/centroids derived from DataMeet India Census-2011 districts (CC BY 2.5 IN); see data/geo/README.md
